summary: Initialize the frozen multi-phase O3a prove-or-refute goal, its max/min subclaims, exact obligations, and three mechanism-distinct routes.

node.title: Multi-phase O3a self-consistency
node.statement: For R>1, integer n>=2, and rho in K_R, normalize the consecutive Dirichlet eigenfunctions by integral rho u_k^2=1 and define F_{n,rho}=lambda_n u_n^2-lambda_{n+1}u_{n+1}^2. A max-self-consistent 2n-phase point is a bang-bang rho with exactly 2n effective switches and rho=R a.e. on {F_{n,rho}>0}, rho=1 a.e. on {F_{n,rho}<0}; a min-self-consistent point obeys the reversed law. Values on the zero set are identified a.e.; effective switches are positive-length cell boundaries and must be zeros of F_{n,rho}.

node.title: Max multi-phase O3a uniqueness
node.statement: For every finite R>1 and integer n>=2, any two max-self-consistent 2n-phase points in the sense of DEF-NGE2-MPO3A-SELFCONSISTENCY coincide a.e.; consequently the unique point, when it exists, is reflection invariant.

node.title: Min multi-phase O3a uniqueness
node.statement: For every finite R>1 and integer n>=2, any two min-self-consistent 2n-phase points in the sense of DEF-NGE2-MPO3A-SELFCONSISTENCY coincide a.e.; consequently the unique point, when it exists, is reflection invariant.

node.title: Universal multi-phase O3a conjecture
node.statement: For every finite R>1, every integer n>=2, and each saturation sign e in {max,min}, any two e-self-consistent 2n-phase points coincide a.e. Consequently the unique point, when it exists, is invariant under reflection x -> 1-x and its ordered switches satisfy x_j+x_{2n+1-j}=1.

node.title: Max saturation rigidity implies max multi-phase O3a
node.statement: The all-n domain, accepted bang-bang and exact-switch theorems, and a valid global phase-rigidity argument imply CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-MAX.
unresolved_obligations: Prove uniqueness of every max-self-consistent residual sheet, or certify two distinct points satisfying every premise.

node.statement: Determine whether CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-ALL is true in CTX-DEFAULT, while separately classifying max and min subclaims.
node.quantifier_contract: For every finite real R>1, every integer n>=2, and each sign max or min, all self-consistent bang-bang points with exactly 2n effective switches coincide a.e.
boundary_cases: R approaches 1 from above and arbitrary large finite R.

node.title: Max multi-phase uniqueness or certified failure
node.statement: Prove max-self-consistent uniqueness for the full quantifier scope or certify two distinct premise-satisfying points.

discharge_criteria: Check all residual zeros, simple crossing or degenerate alternatives, saturation signs, positive cell lengths, eigenvalue indices, and a.e. distinction.

node.title: Direct multi-phase rigidity route
node.statement: Seek a global phase-ratio invariant forcing all self-consistent switch vectors to coincide and hence be reflection invariant.
node.method_family: Transfer matrices, nodal phases, reflection equivariance, quotient dynamics, and global invariants
node.deliverable_contract: A complete rigidity proof, a precise strictly weaker lemma, or the first exact obstruction with restart conditions.
falsification_tests: Audit n=2, both endpoint phases, large finite R, and asymmetric residual sheets.
node.expected_bottleneck: Controlling a 2n-dimensional phase map without assuming symmetry.

node.title: Certified multi-phase counterexample route
node.statement: Search transfer-matrix residual sheets for two distinct self-consistent points and certify every premise by interval arithmetic or an exact reduction.
node.method_family: Transfer matrices, multi-start continuation, interval Newton or Krawczyk certification, and sign-pattern verification
node.deliverable_contract: A verified counterexample or a bounded no-counterexample result with the exact missing proof bridge.
falsification_tests: Reject eigenvalue misindexing, inactive switches, tangencies, reflection duplicates, and null-set differences.
node.expected_bottleneck: Promoting a floating-point witness to a complete interval-certified premise check.

node.title: Small-contrast equivariant bifurcation route
node.statement: Expand at R=1, enumerate first-order phase choices, and continue or exclude asymmetric and multiple self-consistent branches.
node.method_family: Small-contrast Fourier expansion, transversality, equivariant bifurcation, and interval remainder bounds
node.deliverable_contract: A rigorous local uniqueness theorem, a rigorously continued asymmetric or multiple branch, or one exact remaining remainder obligation.
falsification_tests: Enumerate all first-order phase choices for n=2 and n=3.
node.expected_bottleneck: Uniform remainder control and persistence of the full saturation sign pattern.
